extractions.title: Carbon footprint of alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) aquaculture: A two-step systematic literature review
extractions.geography: Not a single study location; international literature/system-level analysis
extractions.study_objective: To identify potential alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon aquaculture and assess their carbon footprint.
extractions.temporal_scope: Literature published 2015–2024 for the first review; second review assessed carbon footprint literature identified subsequently.
focal_factor: alternative protein sources for aquaculture feed
comparison: Explicit comparison of alternative protein sources and their carbon-footprint performance
extractions.evidence_passage: The paper states that the first systematic review identified potential alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon aquaculture and the second assessed the environmental performance of the identified ingredients using carbon footprint as an indicator.

extractions.title: Design, dimensioning, and performance of a research facility for studies on the requirements of fish in RAS environments
extractions.study_objective: To describe the design and dimensioning of the Nofima Centre for Recirculation in Aquaculture (NCRA) and evaluate the initial performance of its RAS facilities for supporting research and production of Atlantic salmon.
extractions.fish_origin: not clearly specified for the performance trials
extractions.temporal_scope: Facility performance was tested in trials during the first 3 years of operation; RAS 1 was started in 2009 and fish tanks were connected in 2010.
comparison: RAS versus flow-through systems in planned/experimental designs
Atlantic salmon growth versus Norwegian smolt-industry performance
extractions.evidence_passage: The full text describes the NCRA facility, its RAS and experimental tank configuration, and two performance trials. Trial 1 assessed Atlantic salmon growth in the facility relative to the Norwegian smolt industry; Trial 2 evaluated water quality and removal efficiencies at increasing feed loads and compared performance with assumptions used during facility design.
extractions.notes: Geography is Norway based on the NCRA facility at Sunndalsøra and the Norwegian field/industry context; US and Chilean author affiliations are not study geographies.
